name: TribesPad
notes: TribesPad owns its release recipe. The build downloads the free official Tribes 2 installer and the TribesNEXT client itself and checks them by SHA-256, so there is no game file to select. Personal builds contain translated game code and the game data and are never published. iPhone and iPad builds without a Mac: Actions → Build TribesPad for iPhone and iPad in a fork of the repository.

commands: brew install llvm@20 cmake ninja sevenzip zstd

steps: Open TribesPad. The game is already inside. Sign in with your TribesNEXT account (CREATE NEW ACCOUNT makes a free one), then PLAY GAME → JOIN lists the internet servers. You join as an observer: press Fire (RT on a controller) to join a team.
No players online? Turn off Settings → Online Play in the ··· menu to start offline, then choose LAN GAME → HOST, enable bots and start a match.
Unzip {file}, move TribesPad to your Applications folder and open it. It needs no Apple account.
Sign in with your TribesNEXT account to join internet servers, or choose LAN GAME → HOST, enable bots and start an offline match.
